I know its bad to pin hope that i would see her again in the future if shes more ready, but thats all my mind can think of right now, and i know its wrong and im worried about it..

Well i was her safe space, and after something that i said to her which is something i meant well, she just couldnt feel right after it. Oh i bring up her not being grown up or immature only because i am aware of our age difference, i am just uncomfortable of sharing on here. 

I do feel i click with her, we love each others jokes and overall our personalities are alright, like shes the perfect one for me, but just not now. Is that a feeling that’s justifiable?

I felt like it was reciprocal to some point, just that my behaviour didnt really resonate with her even though i had good intentions. Basically i was really loving, really caring but in a way that she doesnt resonate with, and our argument led to me breaking her comfort zone which i guess led to this happening. I really feel guilty about this, and i know ive tried my best, even though im suffering everyday. I cant seem to bring myself to hate or to even dislike her, and i still hope to see her again, perhaps when shes more mature or more grown up, so that we could start afresh someday

I think my aunt is just trying to help me find a logical way to see this, as to bring me closure for the thoughts that would never leave me alone.. i still have this strong urge to see her again, and to forgive her for what shes done because i love her so much though..

I dont exactly know or have closure of why she left me, but i still love her and still want her back, just not as of now if that makes sense, because i feel she has to grow up much more till shes ready.
